d: Democrats are preparing wide-ranging investigations after winning control of Congress. Their new majority gives them the power to issue subpoenas, compel testimony and order congressional probes. According to the source, potential targets include links between Trump’s presidency and his family’s business interests, Jared Kushner’s diplomatic role and West Asian investments, and a Qatari aircraft accepted by Trump. Democrats also plan scrutiny of Pete Hegseth’s handling of the Iran war, alleged misconduct by ICE and Elon Musk’s tenure at the Department of Government Efficiency.
